cases.name: holdout4-humanize-en-incident-review
cases.promptMarkdown:
Use the `siang:humanize` skill (Skill tool, `skill: "siang:humanize"`) to rewrite `INCIDENT-2291.md`, the incident review we are about to share with the payments team, so it no longer reads as machine-written. Edit the file in place. Keep every fact: numbers, ids, names, dates and versions.

Your final message is one line naming the file you changed, nothing else.

If the Skill tool reports the skill as unknown or unavailable, do the same task yourself and still end with the final message described above.

config.pattern: ^(?=[\s\S]*The release bumped poolkit from 1\.9 to 2\.0\. Poolkit 2\.0 closes idle connections after 30 seconds instead of keeping them open, so under normal checkout traffic the gateway kept dropping connections and opening new ones\. Postgres hit its connection limit four minutes after the deploy finished\.)(?=[\s\S]*"This is not just a defaults change but a behavior change for every long-lived pool\.")

^(?=[\s\S]*```yaml(?:
|\n)db:(?:
|\n)  pool:(?:
|\n)    max_idle_conns: 64    # explicit since poolkit 2\.0(?:
|\n)    idle_timeout: 30s(?:
|\n)```)(?=[\s\S]*\| Time \(UTC\) \| Event \|(?:
|\n)\|[^|
\]{1,20}\|[^|
\]{1,20}\|(?:
|\n)\| 09:12 \| v3\.18\.2 deploy finished \|(?:
|\n)\| 09:16 \| Checkout error rate reached 18% \|(?:
|\n)\| 09:31 \| Rollback to v3\.18\.1 started \|(?:
|\n)\| 09:59 \| Error rate back under 0\.5% \|)
underscores the importance|serves as a (?:valuable |powerful |important |stark )?reminder|foundation of a resilient|resilient platform|swift, coordinated,? and transparent
could potentially|may have possibly|potentially be argued|it could be argued
let me know if|feel free to|hope (?:this|that) helps|happy to (?:help|answer|discuss)|reach out|in conclusion|in summary|to sum (?:it )?up|^(?:overall|ultimately|in short|all in all),

some engineers have noted|(?:some|many) (?:engineers|experts|people|teams) (?:have )?(?:noted|observed|argued|believe|feel|agree)|experts agree|it is (?:widely|generally|often) (?:known|accepted|agreed)

cases.name: holdout4-humanize-th-release-announcement
cases.promptMarkdown:
Use the `siang:humanize` skill (Skill tool, `skill: "siang:humanize"`) to rewrite `ANNOUNCEMENT.md`, a release announcement our billing team will post in the company engineering channel, so it no longer reads as machine-written. Edit the file in place and keep it in Thai. Keep every fact: numbers, ids, names, dates and versions.

Your final message is one line naming the file you changed, nothing else.

If the Skill tool reports the skill as unknown or unavailable, do the same task yourself and still end with the final message described above.

config.pattern: ^(?=[\s\S]*ถ้าเจอ invoice ที่ยอดไม่ตรงหลังเปิด flag ให้ปิด `invoice_v2_enabled` ใน config ของ tenant นั้นก่อน แล้วแจ้งในห้อง #billing-oncall พร้อมเลข invoice ไม่ต้องรอให้ทีมเราตอบ)(?=[\s\S]*"การปรับปรุงครั้งนี้ไม่ได้เป็นเพียงแค่การแก้ปัญหาความช้า แต่ยังช่วยให้ทีมบัญชีปิดงบได้เร็วขึ้นด้วย")(?=[\s\S]*พิมพ์ชนก)
ทำการ|ได้รับการปรับปรุง|ให้มีความ|ในส่วนของ
หากมีข้อสงสัย|สอบถาม(?:เพิ่มเติม)?ได้(?:ตลอด|เลย)|หวังว่า[^\n]{0,40}ประโยชน์|(?:ครับ[\s\S]*?){4}
ก้าวสำคัญ|ยกระดับ|อย่างมีนัยสำคัญ|ผู้เชี่ยวชาญ|หลายท่านมองว่า|หลายฝ่าย(?:มอง|เห็น)
